ambiguities.text: The index page only lists module names without describing their specific behaviors or interactions.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard Ethereum fork module conventions apply. Each module handles its domain-specific functionality (blocks.py for block processing, transactions.py for transaction handling, etc.).

ambiguities.text: The 'requests.py' module is listed but its purpose is not explained.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this refers to EIP-7685 style execution layer requests mechanism for Prague fork features like validator withdrawals and deposits.

implicit_assumptions.description: The Prague fork modules assume they will be executed in sequence with proper fork activation checks.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Executing Prague-specific logic before fork activation could cause consensus failures or invalid state transitions.

implicit_assumptions.description: The module organization assumes clients will properly load and initialize all submodules before processing begins.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Missing module initialization could cause undefined behavior during transaction or block processing.
